subject: general
question:
The following are the weights (in kg) of 25 students:

58, 55, 53, 50, 53, 51, 52, 54, 53, 52, 54, 53, 58, 53, 59, 55, 53, 52, 51, 54, 53, 59, 55, 53, 52 What is the most commonly observed weight (in kg)?
solution:
**Given:**

The following are the weights (in kg) of 25 students:

58, 55, 53, 50, 53, 51, 52, 54, 53, 52, 54, 53, 58, 53, 59, 55, 53, 52, 51, 54, 53, 59, 55, 53, 52

**Concept:**

Mode = It is the value that appears most often in a set of data values. 

**Calculation:**

Weights of the 25 students in ascending order are as follow:

50, 51, 51, 52, 52, 52, 52, 53, 53, 53, 53, 53, 53, 53, 53, 54, 54, 54, 55, 55, 55, 58, 58, 59, 59

53 kg weight has the highest frequency of 8 times.

**∴ By observing the above data, we can conclude that 53 kg is the most commonly observed weight.**
